subject: Renewal + Expansion: Dedicated GPU pool cutover & canary ops playbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Thompson <elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion: proposal and initial cutover window

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our renewal conversation we'll add 16x NVIDIA A100-equivalent GPUs (two reserved pools) and move from a 6-month to a 12-month committed term with throughput guarantees at the new tier.

Attached is a short PO draft and an initial cutover playbook (cutover_playbook_v1.xlsx) that outlines the canary & traffic-shift approach:
- Day 0 (pre-cutover): final config validation, key rotation check, and dry run of the KV cache warmup script.
- Day 1 (canary): route 5% of production traffic to new pool (region us-west-2), monitor 99th latency, error rate, and token-unit costs.
- Day 2 (ramp): 25% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics healthy; rollback plan if any SLA breach.

Can you confirm target cutover week (we penciled June 21) and whether procurement can accept the attached PO template? If procurement prefers a different format we can mirror it and re-run legal.

Thanks —
Marissa
Acct Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: ACME_PO_DRAFT_v1.pdf (PDF, 12KB)
From: Elena Thompson <elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-06-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposal and initial cutover window

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement confirmed they can accept your PO template but asked for a short appendix that lists data residency, retention, and audit log retention (we'll attach that to the PO). Cutover week of June 21 works for us, but can we move the canary to June 23 to align with an EM release window?

Two asks from our side:
1) A one-page rollback checklist we can give to our SREs (so they know precisely what to flip if latency or 5xx increases).
2) Confirmation on throughput guarantees in writing (99th < 250ms at 50% pool utilization or we fall back to the old pool for partial traffic).

Samir (cc'd) will coordinate procurement-side signatures.

—Elena
VP Engineering, Acme Analytics
elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Thompson <elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposal and initial cutover window

Elena —

Thanks — I've attached a lightweight runbook snippet (traffic-shift-runbook.txt) and embedded a short rollback checklist below. We'll also export the metrics dashboard for your SREs prior to cutover.

Rollback checklist (executive summary):
- If 99th latency > 300ms for longer than 10m or error rate > 0.75% for 5m: pause traffic shift and route all new sessions to existing pool.
- If KV-cache warmup misses expected hit-rate after canary (expected >70% prefix cache hit): abort ramp and fallback to old pool.
- Manual intervention: Rishi (redwood) + Samir (acme) must agree for any permanent switch back.

I'll schedule a 30m pre-cutover dry run with your SREs the week before (June 16-18).

—Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: traffic-shift-runbook.txt (plain text, 4KB)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: procurement@acme-analytics.com, Elena Thompson <elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME PO draft / appendix for retention

Procurement —

Please see the Redwood PO draft attached by Marissa. We need the appendix fields for: data residency (us-west-2), audit log retention (90 days), and confirmation that Redwood's private deployment will not export customer data to third parties. If everyone is good, I'll sign and route this afternoon.

Priyom — can you confirm the final contract addendum language for the throughput SLA? Marissa flagged a 99th percentile latency guarantee; we need the exact phrasing for the PO appendix.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform, Acme Analytics
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elena Thompson <elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME PO draft / appendix for retention

Samir / team —

We can commit to the following SLA appendix language for the PO: 
"Redwood Inference will maintain 99th percentile response latency < 250ms for text-generation endpoints when the Dedicated pool is operating at up to 50% of the provisioned capacity. Redwood will provide metric exports and 24/7 on-call support during the 72-hour cutover window. If the SLA is not met during the authorized ramp, Redwood will execute the rollback plan and issue a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly committed fee for that billing period."

I attached a marked-up PO that includes the appendix and a brief statement on data residency and audit logs. If that language looks good to Acme procurement we can move DocuSign today.

—Priyom
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACME_PO_DRAFT_v1.pdf (annotated, 18KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Thompson <elena.thompson@acme-analytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: Final checklist & confirmed cutover cadence (June 23 canary)

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and final operational asks before June 23 canary:
1) Cutover cadence (agreed):
   - June 22, 09:00 PT: pre-cutover dry run (both sides) — 30m
   - June 23, 02:00 PT: start canary (5% traffic) — monitor 0-4h intensively
   - June 23, 10:00 PT: ramp to 25% if metrics OK
   - June 24, 02:00 PT: ramp to 50%
   - June 25, 02:00 PT: full cutover to new pool (if all gates pass)

2) Gates to progress between stages (must all be green): 99th latency delta < 20% vs baseline (absolute < 250ms), error rate delta < 0.5%, token-cost drift < 8%.
3) Escalation path: on-call SRE (Acme) -> Rishi (redwood on-call) -> Jonas (EM).
4) Rollback triggers and exact steps are in traffic-shift-runbook.txt and will be rehearsed on June 22.
5) DocuSign link will be sent once procurement accepts the annotated PO; Priyom has submitted the language.

Please reply with a quick ack and any outstanding compliance questions. We will also post the final playbook to the shared drive and add an entry to the Jira ticket INF-4821.

Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: cutover_playbook_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
